title: Pearl River Delta thermal mosaic
provenance: REAL_PUBLIC. Open-Meteo ERA5-Land daily 2 m temperatures on a 0.2° lattice plus named city coordinates. Exposure descriptives only. No health outcomes. No project coefficients.

model.outcome: ERA5-Land mean daily Tmin, 2013–2023, 0.2° PRD lattice

slx.formula: mean_tmin ~ X + WX  (X = elevation, lat, lon)
slx.note: Spatial lag of X. Neighbours' elevation and latitude can shift a cell without lagging the outcome.

sar_2sls.formula: mean_tmin ~ elevation_m + lat + lon + W mean_tmin
sar_2sls.note: Anselin 2SLS: WX instruments Wy. R² is a fit diagnostic, not a likelihood.

getis_ord_hn.note: Gi* z-score on annual ERA5 hot-night counts, binary weights including self.

thermal_vs_geographic.note: Euclidean distance in z-scored climate space versus km from Headquarters. High r means climate follows the map; low r means local marine/ridge effects dominate.

model.note: A 0.2° cell is not a city, a weather station, or a hospital catchment. Open-Meteo applies DEM elevation. Do not transport Hong Kong CHD/HF ratios across this mosaic. Live paper stays on HKO Headquarters.
